iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear risk edges higher: Reuters/IAEA-linked material still points to large 60 percent stock and unresolved access/accounting after prior strikes, while fresh watchdog coverage raises proliferation concerns; no verified higher-level enrichment jump or device event surfaced.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: Iran conventional risk remains near-max: RFE/RL and multiple live feeds report renewed US/Israel-Iran exchanges, Kuwait attack fallout, and mixed signals on talks; oil-market reporting still prices Gulf disruption risk even after some hopes for a deal.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon worsened: Reuters, AP, BBC and NYT report Hezbollah rejected the renewed stand-down plan while Israeli strikes continued and killed four; Israeli forces also signaled they would remain in southern positions.

turkey.name: TURKEY
turkey.notes: Turkey remains deterrent: this scan found no fresh Ankara-centered force surge, article-trigger move, or Turkey-NATO kinetic escalation; current results were stale March missile-intercept background.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan stays low elevated: fresh items center on Indian readiness statements, procurement/drones, diplomacy, and unrelated Pakistan internal security rather than border fighting or a bilateral force surge.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO remains imminent mainly via spillover and nuclear signaling: fresh items cite Putin nuclear-threat discussion and Baltic/NATO drone concerns, but no confirmed direct NATO-Russia kinetic contact surfaced.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains critical but not accelerating: Reuters reports Taiwan expanding anti-ship missiles against invasion risk, while the scan found no fresh blockade, landing, or direct clash trigger beyond prior live-fire blockade-simulation evidence.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: DPRK rises inside elevated: AP reports North Korea unveiled a new facility to produce fissile material for its arsenal, while US/Yonhap coverage says Washington remains open to dialogue; no fresh weapons test or device event surfaced.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains near-max: Reuters and fresh RSS items show massive Russian drone/missile barrages and expanding Ukrainian long-range drone attacks, with nuclear-threat rhetoric and NATO spillover concern still present.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan rises: Google News RSS found fresh reports of Taliban capture of a Pakistani outpost and continued border instability despite a lull; older Reuters evidence of airstrike-retaliation dynamics remains relevant.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical: BBC reports dozens killed in an El-Fasher drone strike on a displacement shelter and fresh ICC/war-crimes concern; no separate regional intervention trigger exceeded the existing baseline.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza/Israel-Palestine rises: Reuters and BBC report 10-11 killed in Gaza strikes on June 4 as stand-down efforts falter; humanitarian and political pressure remains high.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN-ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan-Abyei falls to low elevated: no fresh 24h Abyei clash, peacekeeper casualty, or new border-force surge surfaced; returned items were stale background on the disputed region.
